items.text: I really, really wanted to like this game. The initial gameplay loop of exploring wrecks and pulling the copper out of the walls is really fun. I have no idea why they didn't just lean into making that the whole game when they weren't willing to clean up the rest of it. NPC communication is clunky and pointless. The Jobs are very lackluster, they're all just travel somewhere or beat up someone and deal with the inability to keep a prisoner. Survival is trivial. You can live in your EVA suit at the cost of burning through more water and downtime so why bother pressurizing your vessel at all until you're rich and well fed enough for it not to matter and the rewards from one early game salvage run will keep you fed in high quality food for the rest of the game. It's still riddled with bugs, poor communication of mechanics, and has little to do once you get you first ship remodeled and running. This has the skeleton to be an outstanding title, but it would require such a hard pivot from the direction the game has been going in that I don't think it'll ever manifest. The majority of my time was spent repeating the first 10 hours over and over due to constantly have to restart from gamebreaking errors or from being on fast forward and my guy walked outside without his helmet for the fun of it.
items.text_zh: 我真的、真的非常想喜欢这款游戏。最初探索残骸、从墙壁里拽出铜的游戏循环真的很有趣。我不明白为什么他们不愿意把其余部分收拾干净，却不肯干脆把这一点做成整个游戏。NPC交流既笨拙又毫无意义。任务非常乏味，全都只是去某个地方或者揍某个人，还要应付无法关押囚犯的问题。生存要素微不足道。你可以靠你的EVA服活着，代价只是消耗更多水和停机时间，所以在你足够富有、吃得够饱，以至于这些都无所谓之前，何必费心给自己的飞船加压呢？而且早期一次打捞任务的奖励就能让你在游戏剩下的时间里一直吃上高质量食物。它仍然满是bug，机制说明糟糕，而且当你把第一艘船改装好并运转起来后，就几乎没什么可做的了。它具备成为一款杰出作品的骨架，但这需要从游戏一直以来的方向上进行如此艰难的转向，我觉得它永远不会实现。我的大部分时间都花在反复重复最初的10个小时上，因为不断得从破坏游戏的错误中重启，或者因为开着快进而我的角色为了好玩没戴头盔就走到了外面。

observations.evidence: NPC communication is clunky and pointless
observations.evidence_zh: NPC交流既笨拙又毫无意义
